# Delivery routing ruling (e2e synthetic)

Tanya (team owner) ruled on where reaction delivery belongs:

> we route every reaction through one bundle per run per person, not one
> message per skill — a person should get one thing to read, not four

Tina pushed back on the batching window and Tanya held: the bundle closes when
the run closes, and a skill that misses the close waits for the next run rather
than sending on its own. The alternative considered and rejected was per-skill
delivery with client-side collapsing, which moves the ordering problem onto the
reader.

positions.name: ReactionBundleDeliveryRouting
positions.frame: Where should reaction delivery belong: one bundle per run per person, or per-skill delivery where the reader orders the results?
positions.why: All four segments share one directional read: the routing of reactions to a person, and the batching rule that governs it. src-1 frames the ruling, src-2 states the bundling rule and its reader-benefit rationale, src-3 records the batching-window close and Tina's pushback, and src-4 records the rejected per-skill alternative and the cost it would shift onto the reader. Tension is held, not resolved: Tina's pushback on the batching window sits against Tanya's held position, and the bundle-closes-with-run rule means a skill that misses the close waits for the next run instead of sending on its own.

placements.why: The position holds a delivery-routing subject that recurs as the product routes reactions: one bundle per run per person, a batching window that closes with the run, and a rejected per-skill alternative that moves ordering onto the reader. No existing leaf is about delivery routing. Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus is the nearest, since capture and delivery both concern how decisions reach people, so it is recorded as a see-lineage rather than an under. Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate are about positioning and the problem, not routing, so neither holds this. The leaf is a theme (how reactions reach the reader), not a fact about one ruling.
placements.title: One bundle per run replaces a stream of per-skill fragments the reader must order
placements.frame: Where does each reaction land for the person who must act on it: in one bundle per run, or in per-skill pieces the reader has to collect and sequence?
